seo_title: Should You Buy Your Leased Car? Check Your Equity First
takeaways: Ask your leasing company for your buyout price in writing before you turn the car in.
Look up what your exact car is worth today, using more than one source.
If the car is worth more than the buyout, the difference is your equity, and buying may be the better move.
